name: Haunted Knife Collection
disable: DC 26 Religion check (master) to exorcise the spirits, DC 33 Crafting check (expert) to damage the knives, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 29) to counteract the crate
reset: The spirits in the hazard reactivate after 10 minutes.
routine: (3 actions) The knife collection identifies targets. It first moves to have as many living creatures in its space as possible within a single Fly action, then attempts dagger Strikes against living creatures in its space.

items.name: 10,000 Stabs
items.text:
Trigger A living creature touches one of the crates

---
Effect A cloud of knives rises from the boxes in a 10-foot radius around the touched crate and stabs all creatures in its area, dealing 10d4 slashing damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save save). The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: Crates of knives and daggers shine with ill intent.
